long_biography.plain_text:
Samathur Li Kin-kan entered his family's property business during the period when his father, Samuel Tak Lee, led Prudential Enterprise's international expansion. He became a company director and developed a substantial Japanese property portfolio with family capital. Those roles placed him within the family's next generation of management and established him as a Hong Kong real-estate investor.

Li later participated in formalising his father's gift to create an MIT real-estate entrepreneurship laboratory. The programme was designed to support teaching and research in sustainable development, urbanisation and social responsibility, extending the family's property interests into education.
